name: Colossus
introduce:
KX-101HA Colossus
Manufactured by Kamadar, this heavy ST is the culmination of second-generation technology.
Although a newly released model, the KX-101HA Colossus does not rely on a new design as its selling point. Instead, it integrates a large amount of mature and reliable existing technology—heavy composite armor, high-capacity weapon hardpoints, a streamlined shield generator, localized tactical data links, and more. These battle-tested technologies work smoothly together under the integration of the Iron Rain Transmuter, pushing the Colossus's basic performance to the extreme—even significantly ahead of some third-generation STs in certain parameters.

20544.name: Iron Rain Mod
20544.SpecificEffects: Increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>15%</color> when attacking with tactical weapon. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> tactical ammo consumed, additionally increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

30448.name: Sturdy Shield Mod
30448.SpecificEffects: When attacked, if not possessing temporary HP, any undestroyed part having <color=#F74848>70%</color> or less HP gain temporary HP equal to <color=#F74848>15%</color> of that part max HP. When gaining temporary HP, grants <buf ID=7100306>[DMG UP III]</buf> and <buf ID=7100106>[Hit Rate UP III]</buf> to self and <color=#F74848>1</color> random ally within <color=#F74848>2-tile diamond</color> area around self, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
